comment: files.c read_wizkit() -> fopen_wizkit_file() in debug mode with WIZKIT=.nethackrc/kit: access() in the playground fails with ENOENT (2), so C reports "Access to .nethackrc/kit denied (2)." and tries $HOME/.nethackrc/kit. The recorder's HOME holds the .nethackrc file, so that fopen() fails with ENOTDIR (20) and C reports "Couldn't open default gw.wizkit file <HOME>/.nethackrc/kit (20)." with the judge's HOME (recorder patch 010). Each raw_printf() waits for a key before the welcome. Seed, date, Samurai and kit name chosen independently.
